locator.text:
Starting with GitHub Copilot for Eclipse 0.23.0, you will need Eclipse IDE 2025-12 (4.38) or later and Java 21 or later to run Eclipse.

Your projects can keep their existing Java versions. This version of Copilot still supports your current environment.

Please upgrade Eclipse and its Java runtime before updating to 0.23.0. If you cannot upgrade, continue using the last compatible 0.22.x release ZIP from GitHub Releases; it has no commitment to long-term maintenance.
